memories.content: Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and likelihood of completing it. No individual preferences are known at the start.

Calloway Regional Hospital has 400 employees. The annual engagement survey will be open for two weeks starting 2026-09-01T08:00:00-05:00 and ending 2026-09-15T17:00:00-05:00. Employees can complete the survey online during this period. The survey is anonymous and voluntary.
